questions.q: For what kind of reader does the Welcome note say the magazine is meant?
options: This is not what the note says.
Those in a hurry for quick answers
The note speaks of stopping to contemplate.
The note is addressed far more widely.
The discerning individual who stops to contemplate before acting
This is how the note describes its reader.
questions.rationale: This is a magazine for the discerning individual, who stops to contemplate the myriad multitude of choices available, before deciding on a course of action.

questions.q: According to the Chief Editor, what does violence against another person indicate?
options: This is not what the article says.
The article says it is not a sign of power.
It is a pointer to weakness, not a sign of power.
questions.rationale: Any kind of violence perpetrated on another is not a sign of power; it is a pointer to weakness and deficient character.

questions.q: How does the article describe what is generally called tension?
options: The article calls it a natural phenomenon.
The article calls it a blessing in disguise.
The article does not treat it as an illness.
A sign of a healthy life – a blessing in disguise
Tension is the negative term for a positive phenomenon.
questions.rationale: What is generally called tension is, in fact, a sign of a healthy life. It is not an evil but a blessing in disguise.

questions.q: According to the article, what is the existence of man a proof of?
options: This is not the article’s point.
This is not the article’s point.
A likeness of God is to be found in man.
questions.rationale: A likeness of God is to be found in man, for is not the existence of man a proof of the existence of God?

questions.q: What happens to a farmer who wants to reap the harvest on the day of sowing?
options: The article says he loses both seed and harvest.
The article says he is deprived.
He loses the seeds and is deprived of the harvest
So it is with one who wants the reward in today’s world.
The article says he loses everything.
questions.rationale: Any farmer who would like to reap the harvest on the day of sowing the seeds, shall lose the seeds and be deprived of the harvest.

questions.q: What did the Disaster Research Centre at Ohio State University discover?
options: Most people flee at the first warning
In Texas, over half chose to stay.
In moments of crisis an extraordinary new potential develops in people
This potential saves them from succumbing to disasters.
questions.rationale: It was discovered that at moments of crisis, an extraordinary new potential develops in people which saves them from succumbing to disasters and their aftermath.

questions.q: What did the dying billionaire ask of Billy Graham?
options: He said life had lost all meaning.
He was the one with wealth.
“Young man, can you give me a ray of hope?”
questions.rationale: “I am going to take a fateful leap into the unknown. Young man, can you give me a ray of hope?”

questions.q: What makes it possible for man to turn simple matter into buildings and machines?
options: The article points to nature’s constancy.
This is not the reason given.
Everything in nature can be relied upon to act in a certain way.
The article says its properties are constant.
questions.rationale: All matter has been invested by nature with certain constant properties … they are absolutely predictable.

questions.q: What did Lenin first ask his Indian guest, Raja Mohendera Pratap, in 1919?
options: This was not the first question.
This was not the first question.
In which language he should speak
“English, German, French or Russian?” – Lenin had learnt them all.
This was not the first question.
questions.rationale: The first thing Lenin said to his Indian guest was: “In which language should I speak — English, German, French or Russian?”

questions.q: According to the verses quoted (2: 267–268), what does Satan threaten people with?
options: While God promises His forgiveness and His bounty.
questions.rationale: Satan threatens you with the prospect of poverty and commands you to do foul deeds. But God promises His forgiveness and His bounty.
